response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating;

assumptions.assumption: Films with a NULL rating (none expected) would form their own group; the query does not filter them out.

The per-film average of rental_rate / rental_duration is computed per film and then averaged. This is not the same as dividing the average rate by the average duration. rental_duration is NOT NULL and at least 3, so there is no division by zero.
